topic: Repair attempts as explicit experimental events
decision: Record every deterministic or LLM world-graph repair as a versioned experimental event with issue instances, selected and suppressed card identities, graph diff, repair outcome, and execution context.
reason: Attempt adjacency was sufficient to discover persistent error families but could not distinguish card opportunity from actual selection, target repair from clean repair, or local correction from graph-wide collateral change.
reconsider_if: event recording materially affects graph-generation prompts or runtime behavior
stored graph diffs create unacceptable trace size
a simpler event schema preserves the same card-level experimental conclusions
